name: phospholipase C beta 4

function.text: PLCB4 encodes 1-phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate phosphodiesterase beta-4. Annotated molecular activities include C-type glycerophospholipase activity and phosphatidylinositol phospholipase C activity. It participates in phosphatidylinositol-mediated signaling and lipid catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to auriculocondylar syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant); auriculocondylar syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Uveal melanoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
